_: Every song's words. The five traditional songs are their real (public-domain) words, as lines. Each island song is ours, written from the island's story and built around its memory verse (the chorus): sections of verse and chorus, sung in order. The game shows the lines in order, so a chorus is written out each time it's sung.

For the Bible tells me so.
Little ones to Him belong;
They are weak, but He is strong.
Yes, Jesus loves me!
Yes, Jesus loves me!
Yes, Jesus loves me!
The Bible tells me so.
This little light of mine,
I'm gonna let it shine.
This little light of mine,
I'm gonna let it shine.
This little light of mine,
I'm gonna let it shine,
Let it shine, let it shine, let it shine.
Hide it under a bushel? No!
I'm gonna let it shine.

I'm gonna let it shine.

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: God told Noah, "Build a boat,
A great big ark that's going to float."
Noah trusted and obeyed,
Bang, bang, bang, the ark was made!

sections.name: Chorus
lines: Two by two, in they go,
Lions, lambs and sheep in a row.
God kept Noah safe and dry,
And set a rainbow in the sky!

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: Forty days the rain came down,
Over every hill and town.
Inside the ark they fed the bears,
And Noah thanked God in his prayers.

sections.name: Chorus
lines: Two by two, in they go,
Lions, lambs and sheep in a row.
God kept Noah safe and dry,
And set a rainbow in the sky!

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: Then the dove flew back to say
The flood was finally gone away.
God said, "Look up high and see:
My rainbow is My promise to thee!"

sections.name: Chorus
lines: Two by two, in they go,
Lions, lambs and sheep in a row.
God kept Noah safe and dry,
And set a rainbow in the sky!

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: In the beginning there was only God,
Then He said, "Let there be light!"
He made the sky and the splashy sea,
And the sun by day, the stars by night.

sections.name: Chorus
lines: God made the heavens and the earth,
Everything, from the start.
God made everything so good,
And He made me to be His friend!

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: He made the fish that splish and splash,
And the birds that tweet and fly.
He made the lion and the lamb,
And every bug and butterfly.

sections.name: Chorus
lines: God made the heavens and the earth,
Everything, from the start.
God made everything so good,
And He made me to be His friend!

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: Last of all He made people too,
Adam and Eve, made with love.
He looked at all that He had made,
And said, "It's good!" from high above.

sections.name: Chorus
lines: God made the heavens and the earth,
Everything, from the start.
God made everything so good,
And He made me to be His friend!

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: God said, "Abraham, leave your home,
I will show you where to go."
He packed his tents, his sheep, his camels,
And he went, because he trusted so.

sections.name: Chorus
lines: Look up at the sky and count the stars,
One, two, three, and more, and more!
God keeps every promise that He makes,
Just like He did for Abraham before.

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: Abraham and Sarah had no child,
They grew old, and still they prayed.
God said, "Your family will be like the stars,"
And Abraham believed what God had said.

sections.name: Chorus
lines: Look up at the sky and count the stars,
One, two, three, and more, and more!
God keeps every promise that He makes,
Just like He did for Abraham before.

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: They waited and they waited, years and years,
Then baby Isaac came at last!
Sarah laughed with joy, and so did Abraham,
God had kept His promise from the past.

sections.name: Chorus
lines: Look up at the sky and count the stars,
One, two, three, and more, and more!
God keeps every promise that He makes,
Just like He did for Abraham before.

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: Joseph had a coat of many colors,
Red and orange, yellow, green and blue.
But his brothers grumbled, they were jealous,
And they sent him far away, it's true.

sections.name: Chorus
lines: What was meant for bad, God made it good,
God was with Joseph all along.
When things go wrong, God still has a plan,
So trust Him, and forgive, and sing this song!

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: Far away in Egypt, God was with him,
Joseph worked hard, and he was kind.
He told the king what all his dreams were saying:
"Save up food, for hungry years are coming by."

sections.name: Chorus
lines: What was meant for bad, God made it good,
God was with Joseph all along.
When things go wrong, God still has a plan,
So trust Him, and forgive, and sing this song!

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: When his brothers came to buy some food,
Joseph hugged them, every one.
"You meant it for bad, but God meant it for good!"
And the family was together, all as one.

sections.name: Chorus
lines: What was meant for bad, God made it good,
God was with Joseph all along.
When things go wrong, God still has a plan,
So trust Him, and forgive, and sing this song!

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: Moses told the king, "Let my people go!"
Pharaoh said, "No, no, no!"
But at last God's people marched away,
With a cloud by day and a fire to show the way.

sections.name: Chorus
lines: God made a way through the sea,
He made a way for you and me.
When there's no way, God will make one,
His way was through the sea!

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: At the sea the chariots came behind them,
Moses said, "Don't be afraid!"
God sent a wind, the water stood like walls,
And they walked right through on the path God made.

sections.name: Chorus
lines: God made a way through the sea,
He made a way for you and me.
When there's no way, God will make one,
His way was through the sea!

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: Safe on the other side they sang and danced,
Miriam shook her tambourine.
Jingle, jingle, everybody sing:
"Our God is the greatest King!"

sections.name: Chorus
lines: God made a way through the sea,
He made a way for you and me.
When there's no way, God will make one,
His way was through the sea!

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: David was a shepherd boy,
Who sang to God out in the field.
He kept his sheep safe from the lion and the bear,
Because God was his helper and his shield.

sections.name: Chorus
lines: When I am afraid, I will trust in You,
That's what little David sang.
God is bigger than a giant,
When I am afraid, I will trust in You!

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: His brothers were tall, his brothers were strong,
But God looks at the heart.
God chose David to be the king,
Though he was the smallest from the start.

sections.name: Chorus
lines: When I am afraid, I will trust in You,
That's what little David sang.
God is bigger than a giant,
When I am afraid, I will trust in You!

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: Goliath was a giant, big and loud,
But David had a sling and a stone.
"The battle belongs to God!" he said,
And he did not fight alone.

sections.name: Chorus
lines: When I am afraid, I will trust in You,
That's what little David sang.
God is bigger than a giant,
When I am afraid, I will trust in You!

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: Daniel prayed three times a day,
By his window, come what may.
Some jealous men made a sneaky rule,
But Daniel kept on praying anyway.

sections.name: Chorus
lines: God sent His angel to the lions' den,
And He shut the lions' mouths!
Daniel kept on praying, so can I,
God is with me, day and night.

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: Into the den of lions he was thrown,
A stone was rolled across the door.
The king could not sleep, he was so sad,
But Daniel wasn't scared at all anymore.

sections.name: Chorus
lines: God sent His angel to the lions' den,
And He shut the lions' mouths!
Daniel kept on praying, so can I,
God is with me, day and night.

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: In the morning the king ran to the den,
"Daniel, did your God keep you safe?"
"Yes, my God sent His angel," Daniel said,
And the king praised God that very day.

sections.name: Chorus
lines: God sent His angel to the lions' den,
And He shut the lions' mouths!
Daniel kept on praying, so can I,
God is with me, day and night.

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: God said, "Jonah, go to Nineveh,
Tell the people to come back to Me."
But Jonah ran the other way,
And sailed off across the sea.

sections.name: Chorus
lines: God is love, God is love,
He loved Jonah, and He loves you too.
Even when we run away,
God is love, and His love is true!

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: A big wind blew, the boat went up and down,
Splash! Jonah went into the sea.
God sent a great big fish, gulp!
And kept him safe for days, one, two, three.

sections.name: Chorus
lines: God is love, God is love,
He loved Jonah, and He loves you too.
Even when we run away,
God is love, and His love is true!

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: Jonah prayed, "Thank You for saving me,"
And the fish spat him out, bleh!
He went to Nineveh, the people turned to God,
And God forgave them all that day.

sections.name: Chorus
lines: God is love, God is love,
He loved Jonah, and He loves you too.
Even when we run away,
God is love, and His love is true!

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: Thousands came to hear Jesus on the hill,
And their tummies rumbled, grumble, grumble!
A little boy had five loaves and two fish,
And he gave them all to Jesus, oh so humble.

sections.name: Chorus
lines: Give us today our daily bread,
Jesus thanked God, and everyone was fed.
A little lunch in Jesus' hands,
Was enough for everyone, just like He said!

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: Jesus held the bread up and thanked God,
Then He broke it, and His friends passed it round.
More, and more, and more, and more,
Till every tummy was full, up on that ground.

sections.name: Chorus
lines: Give us today our daily bread,
Jesus thanked God, and everyone was fed.
A little lunch in Jesus' hands,
Was enough for everyone, just like He said!

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: Twelve baskets full were left when they were done,
One, two, three, four, five, and more!
What little I have, I'll share with Jesus too,
And He will make it more than ever before.

sections.name: Chorus
lines: Give us today our daily bread,
Jesus thanked God, and everyone was fed.
A little lunch in Jesus' hands,
Was enough for everyone, just like He said!

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: Baby Moses in a basket,
Floating on the river Nile.
His mama hid him in the reeds,
And Miriam watched him all the while.

sections.name: Chorus
lines: Don't be afraid, I am with you,
God was watching, God had a plan.
He kept baby Moses safe and sound,
And He holds me in His hand.

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: A princess came down to the river,
And she heard the baby cry.
She lifted him up, she loved him so,
And she said, "I'll keep him, I will try."

sections.name: Chorus
lines: Don't be afraid, I am with you,
God was watching, God had a plan.
He kept baby Moses safe and sound,
And He holds me in His hand.

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: Miriam ran up, "I know a mama
Who can feed him!" So she did.
Moses grew up safe inside the palace,
God took care of that little kid.

sections.name: Chorus
lines: Don't be afraid, I am with you,
God was watching, God had a plan.
He kept baby Moses safe and sound,
And He holds me in His hand.

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: Moses led his sheep across the desert,
To the mountain of God one day.
He saw a bush all bright with fire,
But it did not burn away!

sections.name: Chorus
lines: "Certainly I will be with you,"
That's what God said to Moses.
Wherever He sends me, He goes too,
God will always be with me!

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: "Take off your shoes, this ground is holy,"
God called out from the flame.
"I have seen My people crying in Egypt,
Go and set them free, in My name."

sections.name: Chorus
lines: "Certainly I will be with you,"
That's what God said to Moses.
Wherever He sends me, He goes too,
God will always be with me!

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: "But who am I?" said Moses, "I can't do it!"
God said, "I'll be with you all the way."
So Moses went to Egypt, trusting God,
And God was with him every day.

sections.name: Chorus
lines: "Certainly I will be with you,"
That's what God said to Moses.
Wherever He sends me, He goes too,
God will always be with me!

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: Out in the desert, hot and dry,
The people grumbled, "We're hungry!"
But God still loved them, and He said,
"I will rain down bread from the sky."

sections.name: Chorus
lines: Bread from heaven every morning,
Manna, manna, sweet as honey!
God gave enough for every day,
God takes care of me, and He takes care of you!

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: In the evening came the quail,
Little birds all through the camp.
In the morning, little flakes like frost,
"What is it?" they said. God's bread, that's what!

sections.name: Chorus
lines: Bread from heaven every morning,
Manna, manna, sweet as honey!
God gave enough for every day,
God takes care of me, and He takes care of you!

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: "Gather just enough for today,"
Moses said, "God will send more."
Every morning God kept His word,
Forty years, just like before!

sections.name: Chorus
lines: Bread from heaven every morning,
Manna, manna, sweet as honey!
God gave enough for every day,
God takes care of me, and He takes care of you!

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: Jericho had walls so big and strong,
But God gave Joshua a plan.
"March around the city, blow the trumpets,
And trust Me, every woman, child and man."

sections.name: Chorus
lines: March, march, round and round,
Toot, toot, toot, the trumpets sound!
By faith the walls of Jericho fell down,
When God's people trusted Him, the walls came down!

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: Rahab tied a red cord in her window,
She believed in the one true God.
God kept her and her family safe,
Because she trusted Him, and that's not odd!

sections.name: Chorus
lines: March, march, round and round,
Toot, toot, toot, the trumpets sound!
By faith the walls of Jericho fell down,
When God's people trusted Him, the walls came down!

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: Six days they marched around just once,
On the seventh, seven times.
Then everybody gave a mighty shout,
And crash! The walls fell down, all at one time!

sections.name: Chorus
lines: March, march, round and round,
Toot, toot, toot, the trumpets sound!
By faith the walls of Jericho fell down,
When God's people trusted Him, the walls came down!

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: Naomi was going home to Bethlehem,
She was sad, and she was all alone.
But Ruth hugged her tight and said, "I'm coming,
Where you go, I'll go, your home's my home."

sections.name: Chorus
lines: "Your people will be my people,
And your God will be my God."
Ruth was faithful, Ruth was kind,
And God took care of them, both of them!

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: Ruth picked up the barley left behind,
In the golden field all day.
Kind Boaz said, "Take all you need,"
And he sent her home with more to say.

sections.name: Chorus
lines: "Your people will be my people,
And your God will be my God."
Ruth was faithful, Ruth was kind,
And God took care of them, both of them!

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: Ruth and Boaz had a baby, little Obed,
And Naomi laughed with joy again.
Obed's grandson was King David,
God had a plan for Ruth, way back then!

sections.name: Chorus
lines: "Your people will be my people,
And your God will be my God."
Ruth was faithful, Ruth was kind,
And God took care of them, both of them!

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: Hannah prayed and prayed for a baby,
And God gave her Samuel, her boy.
She brought him to God's house to serve,
And Samuel was her joy.

sections.name: Chorus
lines: Speak, Lord, I am listening,
Speak, Lord, I am listening.
Samuel heard God call his name,
And I can listen too, just the same!

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: One night in bed he heard a voice:
"Samuel! Samuel!" one, two, three.
He ran to Eli, "Here I am!"
But Eli said, "It isn't me."

sections.name: Chorus
lines: Speak, Lord, I am listening,
Speak, Lord, I am listening.
Samuel heard God call his name,
And I can listen too, just the same!

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: Then Eli knew, "It's God who's calling,
Go and say, Speak, Lord, I hear."
So Samuel listened, and God spoke,
And Samuel served Him year by year.

sections.name: Chorus
lines: Speak, Lord, I am listening,
Speak, Lord, I am listening.
Samuel heard God call his name,
And I can listen too, just the same!

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: No rain fell for a long, dry time,
The grass turned brown, the ground went dry.
But God sent ravens to Elijah,
With bread and meat, flap, flap, through the sky.

sections.name: Chorus
lines: My God will supply every need,
Every need of mine.
He fed Elijah by the brook,
And He takes care of me all the time!

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: A widow had one last little loaf,
But she shared it with Elijah too.
And her flour and her oil never ran out,
God kept it full the whole year through.

sections.name: Chorus
lines: My God will supply every need,
Every need of mine.
He fed Elijah by the brook,
And He takes care of me all the time!

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: On the mountain Elijah prayed to God,
And fire came down from above!
"The Lord, He is God!" the people cried,
Then the rain came pouring down with love.

sections.name: Chorus
lines: My God will supply every need,
Every need of mine.
He fed Elijah by the brook,
And He takes care of me all the time!

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: Esther was a girl with no mom or dad,
Mordecai raised her with love.
The king chose Esther to be his queen,
With a crown, and God watched from above.

sections.name: Chorus
lines: Be strong and brave, don't be afraid,
God made you for a time like this.
Esther was brave, and God used her,
Be strong and brave, don't be afraid!

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: Proud Haman made a wicked plan
To hurt God's people, every one.
Mordecai sent word to the queen:
"Maybe this is why God made you queen!"

sections.name: Chorus
lines: Be strong and brave, don't be afraid,
God made you for a time like this.
Esther was brave, and God used her,
Be strong and brave, don't be afraid!

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: Esther prayed, then went to see the king,
Though she could have lost her life.
"Please save my people!" and the king said yes,
God saved them all through one brave wife.

sections.name: Chorus
lines: Be strong and brave, don't be afraid,
God made you for a time like this.
Esther was brave, and God used her,
Be strong and brave, don't be afraid!

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: When Jesus was a boy of twelve,
He walked up to Jerusalem.
For the Passover feast, with family and friends,
Singing songs along with them.

sections.name: Chorus
lines: "I must be in My Father's house,"
That's what young Jesus said.
He loved to learn about His Father,
And He grew up wise, and good, and kind!

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: When the feast was done, they all went home,
But Jesus stayed behind.
Mary and Joseph looked everywhere,
"Where is Jesus? Where? We have to find!"

sections.name: Chorus
lines: "I must be in My Father's house,"
That's what young Jesus said.
He loved to learn about His Father,
And He grew up wise, and good, and kind!

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: After three days they found Him in the temple,
Asking questions, listening too.
Then He went home, and He obeyed His parents,
And He grew in wisdom, through and through.

sections.name: Chorus
lines: "I must be in My Father's house,"
That's what young Jesus said.
He loved to learn about His Father,
And He grew up wise, and good, and kind!

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: Peter fished all night and caught nothing,
Not one fish, his nets were bare.
Then Jesus said, "Go out where it's deep,
And let your nets down there."

sections.name: Chorus
lines: "Come, follow Me," said Jesus,
"I will make you fishers of men."
They left their boats and followed Him,
Come, follow Me, again and again!

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: Peter said, "Because You say so, I will,"
And splash! The nets were full!
So many fish the nets began to break,
Both boats sank low with every pull.

sections.name: Chorus
lines: "Come, follow Me," said Jesus,
"I will make you fishers of men."
They left their boats and followed Him,
Come, follow Me, again and again!

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: Peter knelt down, "Lord, You are amazing!"
Jesus said, "Don't be afraid.
From now on you'll bring people to God,"
And they followed Jesus from that day.

sections.name: Chorus
lines: "Come, follow Me," said Jesus,
"I will make you fishers of men."
They left their boats and followed Him,
Come, follow Me, again and again!

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: Jesus and His friends sailed across the lake,
And Jesus fell asleep.
Then the wind blew hard, and the waves splashed in,
And the boat was rocking in the deep.

sections.name: Chorus
lines: "Peace, be still," said Jesus,
And the storm became calm.
The wind and the waves obey Him,
So when I'm scared, I'm safe in His arms.

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: "Teacher, wake up, don't You care?"
His friends were so afraid.
Jesus stood and spoke to the wind and the sea,
And just like that, the storm obeyed.

sections.name: Chorus
lines: "Peace, be still," said Jesus,
And the storm became calm.
The wind and the waves obey Him,
So when I'm scared, I'm safe in His arms.

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: "Who is this?" His friends all said,
"Even the wind does what He says!"
Jesus is God's Son, He's stronger than a storm,
And He is with me all my days.

sections.name: Chorus
lines: "Peace, be still," said Jesus,
And the storm became calm.
The wind and the waves obey Him,
So when I'm scared, I'm safe in His arms.

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: A shepherd had one hundred sheep,
He loved them every one.
He counted them at night: ninety-nine!
One little lamb was gone.

sections.name: Chorus
lines: "Rejoice with me, I found my sheep,
The one that was lost is found!"
That's how God feels about you and me,
He looks till every one is found!

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: He looked over the hills, behind the rocks,
"Little lamb, where are you?" he called.
Then he heard a little "Baa!" in a bush,
The lamb was scared, but safe, that's all.

sections.name: Chorus
lines: "Rejoice with me, I found my sheep,
The one that was lost is found!"
That's how God feels about you and me,
He looks till every one is found!

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: He lifted up the lamb onto his shoulders,
And he carried it all the way home.
He called his friends, "Come and celebrate!"
Jesus said, that's how God loves His own.

sections.name: Chorus
lines: "Rejoice with me, I found my sheep,
The one that was lost is found!"
That's how God feels about you and me,
He looks till every one is found!

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: A man was walking down a rocky road,
When robbers hurt him and ran away.
A priest walked by, a helper hurried past,
Nobody stopped to help that day.

sections.name: Chorus
lines: Love your neighbor as yourself,
That's what Jesus said to do.
Stop and help, be kind to everyone,
Love your neighbor, and I will too!

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: Then a Samaritan came riding by,
He stopped, because he cared.
He washed the hurts and wrapped them up,
And lifted the man onto his donkey there.

sections.name: Chorus
lines: Love your neighbor as yourself,
That's what Jesus said to do.
Stop and help, be kind to everyone,
Love your neighbor, and I will too!

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: He took him to an inn and paid the bill,
"Take good care of him," he said.
"Who was the neighbor?" Jesus asked,
"The one who was kind. Now go and do the same."

sections.name: Chorus
lines: Love your neighbor as yourself,
That's what Jesus said to do.
Stop and help, be kind to everyone,
Love your neighbor, and I will too!

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: Zacchaeus was a little man,
Who took more money than he should.
Nobody liked Zacchaeus much,
But he wanted to see Jesus if he could.

sections.name: Chorus
lines: Jesus came to seek and save the lost,
He knew Zacchaeus by his name.
"Hurry down, I'm coming to your house!"
And Zacchaeus was never the same!

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: The crowd was tall, so he climbed a tree,
Up, up, up, so he could see.
Jesus stopped right under that tree and said,
"Zacchaeus, come down, and eat with Me!"

sections.name: Chorus
lines: Jesus came to seek and save the lost,
He knew Zacchaeus by his name.
"Hurry down, I'm coming to your house!"
And Zacchaeus was never the same!

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: Zacchaeus said, "I'll give back what I took,
Four times more, and half to the poor!"
Jesus loved him first, and that changed everything,
His heart was new, not like before.

sections.name: Chorus
lines: Jesus came to seek and save the lost,
He knew Zacchaeus by his name.
"Hurry down, I'm coming to your house!"
And Zacchaeus was never the same!

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: Jesus rode a little donkey,
Clip, clop, down the hill.
The people laid their coats upon the road,
And waved their palms with a happy thrill.

sections.name: Chorus
lines: Hosanna! Hosanna!
Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord!
Hosanna! Hosanna!
Jesus is the King, let's wave our palms and sing!

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: "Go find a donkey no one's ridden,"
Jesus told His friends that day.
They brought it, and they made a seat of coats,
And Jesus rode it all the way.

sections.name: Chorus
lines: Hosanna! Hosanna!
Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord!
Hosanna! Hosanna!
Jesus is the King, let's wave our palms and sing!

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: The children shouted, the grown-ups sang,
The whole city came to see.
A gentle King on a little donkey,
Jesus came for you and me.

sections.name: Chorus
lines: Hosanna! Hosanna!
Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord!
Hosanna! Hosanna!
Jesus is the King, let's wave our palms and sing!

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: Jesus shared a supper with His friends,
Bread and a cup, "Remember Me."
Then He died upon the cross for us,
Because He loves us, you and me.

sections.name: Chorus
lines: He is not here, He is risen!
Jesus is alive, just like He said!
The stone is rolled away, the tomb is empty,
Jesus is alive, He's alive, He's alive!

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: They laid Him in a tomb inside a garden,
And rolled a great big stone across the door.
His friends were sad and missed Him so,
But that was not the end, there was more!

sections.name: Chorus
lines: He is not here, He is risen!
Jesus is alive, just like He said!
The stone is rolled away, the tomb is empty,
Jesus is alive, He's alive, He's alive!

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: Early Sunday morning Mary came,
The stone was gone, the tomb was bare.
An angel said, "Don't be afraid, He's alive!"
And then she saw Him standing there!

sections.name: Chorus
lines: He is not here, He is risen!
Jesus is alive, just like He said!
The stone is rolled away, the tomb is empty,
Jesus is alive, He's alive, He's alive!

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: Jesus said, "Wait in Jerusalem,
My Father will send you a Helper from above."
Then He went up to heaven in a cloud,
And His friends prayed together with love.

sections.name: Chorus
lines: The Spirit came like wind and fire,
The Helper Jesus promised came to stay.
And the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace,
Growing in me every day!

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: Whoosh! A wind blew through the room,
And little flames came down on each one.
They told the good news in every language,
"Jesus is alive! He is God's Son!"

sections.name: Chorus
lines: The Spirit came like wind and fire,
The Helper Jesus promised came to stay.
And the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace,
Growing in me every day!

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: Three thousand people joined them that day,
They shared their food, they prayed, they sang.
The Holy Spirit lives in all who trust in Jesus,
And He helps me to be kind, and brave, and strong.

sections.name: Chorus
lines: The Spirit came like wind and fire,
The Helper Jesus promised came to stay.
And the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace,
Growing in me every day!
